messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU pool 'hotpath-3a' saturation detected — sustained queue growth + 429s. severity=P1. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/alerts/2255556666

elaine: acked. I'm on it — starting with autoscaler and token-bucket metrics. tagging @max for token bucket config visibility.

max: on my way. quick context: when queue depth spikes the token/leaky-bucket enforcer for lower tiers will start returning 429s; also check autoscaler max_replicas and cooldown windows.

elaine: pulling recent logs and metrics. queue length jumped from ~30 -> ~120 in 8m, p95 latency spiked to 4.2s, 429 rate ~78%.

elaine: running quick checks on controller:
```
kubectl -n inference get hpa gpu-hotpath-3a -o yaml
# shows targetCPU: 70, currentReplicas: 6, maxReplicas: 6
```

jordan: that HPA config looks capped (maxReplicas=6). autoscaler should've bumped more — might be hitting global pool cap in cluster-resources. I see recent deploy that tightened quotas yesterday.

elaine: can we bump? doing emergency scale now (manual) to buy time.

elaine: run: `kubectl scale deploy/gpu-hotpath-3a --replicas=18 -n inference`

incident-bot: deploy-change detected by CI: manual scale by elaine at 2026-03-15T22:13:10Z.

elaine: scaled to 18. observing...

elaine: immediate effect: queue drained from 120 -> 25 in ~3m, 429s dropped to ~22%. still some 429s for lower-priority tiers.

cs-ivy: outages for customer FinLedger: they report ~95% request failures during spike window (22:05-22:15 UTC). Do we need to notify CS/AE?

elaine: yes please notify. adding mitigation note: priority tiers restored first, lower tiers still seeing sporadic rejections while token buckets refill.

max: let's adjust token/leaky-bucket for tier 'enterprise-high' and 'paying-standard' temporarily to increase burst and refill rate for enterprise customers. POSTing to admin API:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/internal/tokenbuckets/tiers/enterprise-high" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"rate_per_sec": 2500, "burst": 8000}'
```

max: response: 200 OK — updated. same for 'paying-standard' to rate_per_sec=1200, burst=3000.

elaine: after token bucket bump, enterprise 429s down to 1.5%, overall 429s ~8% and latency p95 back to 1.1s.

jordan: root cause hypothesis: autoscaler was constrained by a recently lowered cluster quota (cluster-capacity-policy). when queue grew, controllers couldn't request more nodes/GPUs; HPA maxReplicas was set low and global quota prevented scale. Token bucket settings were conservative and caused hard 429s for non-priority tiers. need two follow-ups: 1) revert quota/hpa limits change and validate autoscaler can scale to target; 2) review default token bucket profiles to avoid immediate hard-reject on short surges.

sre-lead: agreed. creating incident task list and assigning owners.

sre-lead: tasks created: INC-2255 - emergency mitigation summary (elaine), INC-2256 - quota + autoscaler config rollback (jordan), INC-2257 - token-bucket profile review and guardrails (max), INC-2258 - customer outreach and RCA draft (cs-ivy).

elaine: handing off to night oncall (jordan) in 20m. current state: manual scale=18 holds, token buckets bumped, 429s low but not zero. outstanding: ensure autoscaler can resume normal operation and confirm cluster quota rollback.

jordan: taking handoff. I will keep watch for next 2 hours and validate autoscaler resumes. if queue grows again, I'll re-run scaling and open a node-pool increase request.

oncall-bot: Handoff: Incident 2255556666 -> oncall: jordan. Summary: GPU pool saturated due to quota + low HPA cap; manual scale + token-bucket tuning reduced customer impact. Follow runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/gpu-sat. Remember to escalate to infra if nodepool requests fail.

elaine: quick note for postmortem: timeline, config change that tightened quotas (author: infra-config-bot on 2026-03-15T18:20Z), autoscaler metrics, customer impact window (22:05-22:15 UTC), mitigation steps (manual scale, token-bucket bump), need permanent fix and tests.

cs-ivy: contacting FinLedger now with bridge summary and ETA for RCA.

max: recommended permanent change: add a preflight check in deploy pipeline that verifies HPA maxReplicas <= cluster quota. also add a sliding-burst policy for token buckets to allow controlled spillover on short sudden surges.

jordan: noted. I'll validate overnight and assign follow-ups. leaving logs and commands run in thread for handoff. good work team. :thumbsup:
